description: Verify and optimize existing PWA icons for full compliance. The app already has professionally designed icons with the unslump! brand identity (4-color layered 'u!' design). This task focuses on ensuring proper icon configuration, adding maskable icon variants, and verifying Lighthouse PWA audit compliance.

phases.name: Icon Audit & Analysis
phases.description: Analyze current icons and identify gaps for PWA compliance

subtasks.title: Verify current icon dimensions and quality
subtasks.description: Check that icon-192.png is exactly 192x192, icon-512.png is exactly 512x512, apple-touch-icon.png is 180x180, and og-image.png is 1200x630. Verify image quality and file sizes.
acceptance_criteria: og-image.png is 1200x630 pixels for social sharing
All images have appropriate file sizes (optimized but not over-compressed)
subtasks.notes: Verified all icon dimensions and quality. icon-192.png (192x192, 5.7K), icon-512.png (512x512, 18K), apple-touch-icon.png (180x180, 5.3K), og-image.png (1200x630, 38K). All icons have excellent quality with professional 4-color 'u!' design and optimized file sizes.

subtasks.title: Analyze manifest.json icon configuration
subtasks.description: Review the current manifest icon configuration. The current setup uses 'any maskable' combined purpose which is not recommended - maskable icons need special safe zone considerations.
acceptance_criteria: Identify issues with current 'any maskable' combined purpose
Document required changes for proper PWA compliance

phases.name: Create Maskable Icon Variants
phases.description: Create properly designed maskable icons with content in the safe zone

subtasks.title: Create maskable SVG template
subtasks.description: Create a new SVG template for maskable icons where the logo content fits within the inner 80% safe zone circle. Maskable icons should have padding around the logo so it displays correctly when masked to circles, rounded squares, etc.
acceptance_criteria: New SVG template created with proper safe zone padding
Logo content centered within 80% inner circle

subtasks.title: Generate maskable PNG icons
subtasks.description: Generate maskable-192.png and maskable-512.png from the maskable SVG template. These will be used for Android adaptive icons and other platforms that apply masks.
acceptance_criteria: Icons display correctly when circular mask is applied

phases.name: Update Manifest & Configuration
phases.description: Update manifest.json with proper icon configuration separating any and maskable purposes

subtasks.title: Update manifest.json icon array
subtasks.description: Modify manifest.json to have separate icon entries: regular icons with 'any' purpose and maskable icons with 'maskable' purpose. This follows PWA best practices.

subtasks.title: Update service worker cache
subtasks.description: Increment service worker version and add new maskable icons to the cache list for offline support.
acceptance_criteria: New maskable icons added to urlsToCache array

phases.name: Verification & Testing
phases.description: Verify all icons work correctly and pass PWA audits

subtasks.title: Run Lighthouse PWA audit
subtasks.description: Build the project and run Lighthouse PWA audit to verify all icon requirements pass. Check for installability, icon presence, and maskable icon support.
acceptance_criteria: Lighthouse PWA audit passes icon checks

subtasks.title: Visual verification across platforms
subtasks.description: Verify icons display correctly in different contexts: browser tab (favicon), iOS home screen (apple-touch-icon), Android home screen (maskable), and social sharing previews (og-image).
acceptance_criteria: Favicon displays correctly in browser tab
Apple touch icon renders properly on iOS
Maskable icon displays correctly with circular mask
OG image shows correctly in link previews

qa_checklist: All PWA icons present: icon-192.png, icon-512.png, maskable-192.png, maskable-512.png
Apple touch icon (apple-touch-icon.png) properly sized at 180x180
Manifest.json has correct icon configuration with separate purposes
Service worker caches all icon assets
Lighthouse PWA audit passes all icon-related checks
Maskable icons have proper safe zone padding
